title.source: Save this research to your account
title.text: 将此研究保存到您的账户

introduction.source: This private link can be used once within 24 hours. Claiming adds the saved run to your history. It does not change who paid or any payment or creator reward.
introduction.text: 此私密链接可在 24 小时内使用一次。认领会将已保存研究添加到您的历史记录。它不会更改付款者、任何付款或创作者奖励。

memory.source: The link has been removed from this address bar. Keep this tab open while signing in. Reloading or closing it loses this copy of the link; Keryx cannot reissue it.
memory.text: 链接已从地址栏移除。登录期间请保持此标签页打开。重新加载或关闭会丢失此链接副本；Keryx 无法重新签发。

signIn.source: Sign in in a separate window

ready.source: Confirm the account below, then save this research.
ready.text: 确认下方账户，然后保存此研究。

signedOut.source: Sign in, then return to this tab and check your account.
signedOut.text: 登录后返回此标签页检查账户。

changed.source: Your signed-in account changed. Check the account below before confirming again.
changed.text: 已登录账户发生变化。再次确认前请检查下方账户。

saved.source: This research is now in this account’s private history. Its original payment records are unchanged.
saved.text: 此研究已加入此账户的私密历史记录。原始付款记录保持不变。

unavailable.source: This claim link is unavailable. It may be invalid, expired, already used or no longer eligible.
unavailable.text: 此认领链接不可用。它可能无效、已过期、已使用或不再符合条件。

serviceUnavailable.source: Run claims are unavailable on this deployment.
serviceUnavailable.text: 此部署不提供研究认领功能。

authUnavailable.source: Your signed-in account could not be checked. Try checking again.
authUnavailable.text: 无法检查已登录账户。请再次检查。

unconfirmed.source: The claim request could not be confirmed. Check your private history. This tab will not submit the link again.
unconfirmed.text: 无法确认认领请求。请检查私密历史记录。此标签页不会再次提交链接。
